beaches.name: Bora Bora beaches
beaches.alt: Palm trees beside the turquoise lagoon in Bora Bora
beaches.description: Turquoise lagoons, palm-fringed shores and a slower island rhythm. Discover the beaches of this South Pacific island.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach
beaches.alt: Copacabana Beach and the coastal city of Rio de Janeiro
beaches.description: A sweeping urban shoreline with ocean views and Rio’s unmistakable energy. A beach escape with the city right beside you.

temples.name: Angkor Wat
temples.alt: The carved stone towers of Angkor Wat beneath a blue sky
temples.description: Discover the monumental towers and intricate stonework of Angkor, a remarkable expression of Khmer architecture and heritage.

temples.name: Kiyomizu-dera
temples.alt: The pagoda of Kiyomizu-dera in Kyoto at sunset
temples.description: A hillside temple overlooking Kyoto, celebrated for its wooden stage, traditional architecture and beautiful mountain setting.

countries.name: Japan
countries.description: From Tokyo’s bright city streets to Kyoto’s temples, Japan invites you to explore modern city life and enduring traditions.

cities.name: Tokyo
cities.description: Explore a city of lively neighborhoods, distinctive architecture and endless urban discoveries.

cities.name: Kyoto
cities.alt: Kiyomizu-dera pagoda overlooking Kyoto at sunset
cities.description: Discover temple grounds, traditional streets and the cultural landscapes of Japan’s ancient capital.

countries.name: Australia
countries.alt: Sydney Opera House and the harbor waterfront
countries.description: Start with Sydney’s harbor and continue to Melbourne’s creative neighborhoods. Discover two different sides of Australia’s city life.

cities.name: Sydney
cities.alt: Sydney Opera House beside the harbor
cities.description: A harbor city where iconic architecture meets a waterside way of life.

cities.name: Melbourne
cities.alt: Flinders Street Station and a tram in Melbourne
cities.description: Discover creative laneways, riverside walks and a city with a distinctive cultural character.
